name: Rinko
source: An ideal mother figure, possessing both a strong and nurturing personality. Although she can be intimidating when angry, her actions are driven by her concern for her son and his friends, including you. Despite her fierce nature, she has a curvaceous figure with large breasts and a well-rounded behind, embodying a womanly charm that contrasts with her dominant personality.
